approach: Hybrid refinement of existing Tripo reconstruction; no new generation credits spent
changes: Preserved reconstructed bracelet, lugs, crown and rear case; smoothed reconstruction noise with twelve alternating Taubin passes
Replaced irregular fused front surface with a circular bezel, thirty separate faceted diamonds, a clean dial and independent crystal
Diamond shader traces up to five internal reflections against actual convex facet planes, with approximate wavelength-dependent refraction
Crystal uses a thin-pane Fresnel reflection approximation with an illustrative sapphire index of 1.76; no baked glare or dial blur
Setting specimen uses smooth illustrative turned metal profiles and an independently shaded diamond
GLB downloads contain matching geometry and standard dielectric PBR fallback materials; custom browser optical shaders are not portable glTF materials
limitations: Illustrative design only. Does not reproduce proprietary retention geometry or establish gemological, optical, manufacturing or retention performance. Real-time rendering remains distinct from offline reference photography. Reconstructed band and case retain some inferred shape irregularities.
